body:
2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Roadworks on Smithy Bridge Road in Littleborough scheduled for 15 November 2026 (Littleborough). Temporary road closures will affect Smithy Bridge Road and surrounding areas during early hours on 15 November 2026.

Homes evacuated in Rochdale after car crashes into house and causes gas leak (Rochdale). Emergency services evacuated around 55 residents after a car collided with a property on Halifax Road, leading to a gas leak.

Weather: Overcast 12°C in Rochdale today.
